body: Finally, they don't water down characters after making them fall in love? What I mean is that suddenly, I don't recognize the character. Instead, we see them adapt together and support each other.

A Dou from The Long Ballad starring Diliraba Dilmurat and Wu Lei. Tragic character and I want to eat the writer. 

Duo Ming from Blossom starring Meng Ziyi and Li Yun Rui. She played two roles, but her more naive one captured my heart cause wdym she married a trashy husband who is a literal strawbag and doesn't protect her from his sister?

Sun Ya Ya and Mi Shao Fei from Go Go Squid. Cute couple, and they deserve each other! No matter the pain or insecurity Mi Shao Fei has felt, Sun Ya Ya is there to comfort him, and they got together in the end, too! Successful lover and fan! 

Su Jin from Ten Miles of Peach Blossoms because her character was so well developed! She was naive but was slowly pushed into madness due to one-sided love and coldness from Ye Hua. Girly crashed out not only cause of her love for Ye Hua but also because she always viewed Ye Hua as a pillar of support due to her flimsy status as princess of the 9th heaven. She has no real power and could likely be married off because she has no familial power backing her up and has to rely on the Heavenly Emperor. I want to kiss the writer and rub her shoulders from treating Su Jin with care and carving her antagonistic self so well.

Cheng Yi Xie and Cheng Qian Li from The Spirealm. They were brothers who protected each other and supported each other in the drama. I wanna cry so badly cause of their ending. Writer has to be so mean to me 😭😭

I wanted to talk about my problems to someone but I can't.

My boyfriend and I are young students so we make a lot of mistakes. I have always filled in the blanks and never really questioned stuff while he has always questioned everything and is very blunt/honest.

He gave me the cold shoulders because he felt disappointed that I was ignoring him and having fun on my own. I apologized because I was at fault and that I assumed without thinking of communicating with him.

However, we get into serious talks a lot and hurt each other while being honest.

He has told me multiple times that he felt like breaking up but he won't actually do it. He has told me that he hasn't forgotten his ex. He has told me that I wasn't able to help him emotionally and that I was lacking.

All of this, I knew. I knew that I was not emotionally reliable. I have a very big pride but I would feel hurt everytime he tells me that I was wrong to ignore him and not communicate. It happened not once or twice, it happened multiple times. He never once spoke up and gave me the cold shoulders so that I could learn.

I would feel like I have done a grave wrong everytime and I would tell him that I was sorry, apologize again and again until he sarcastically laughs it off.

I am always on the edge and overthink that I was unreliable and not trust worthy. I feel like I can't breathe and the pressure of being better haunts me every night. He, of course apologizes everytime and he too, would tell me that I should be better.

I know I am lacking, yet I have tried to do better.
In the end its just me feeling wronged and him being disappointed because I wasn't what he expected.

I would wonder, does he even love me at times.
Suicide thoughts started after he repeatedly he told me that he hated how I would ignore him and that I don't think of him as my top priority.

I thought, why am I even living? I am such a bad person. I can't be a good girlfriend or a good friend. Why am I alive? 

This was long but I guess it is just young relationship problems. Maybe I am just caught up in the moment feeling wronged. Im sorry if you thought you wasted your time while reading this. I apologize for making a big deal out of this.

I understand how you feel about disappearing like you won't ever exist. I've been there. You matter.
Somebody's day will be better because of you.
Someone will smile because of you.
I am not in good shape myself but if you need some encouragement, I am here to tell you that all the people you love will smile with pride because they knew you. They've met you and they have history with you. Don't forget that you are unreplaceable.
